Install Stage 1 reactor coil_row12 (10 mL, 2.4 mm ID, ETFE) at 95 deg C.
Install Stage 2 reactor coil_row11 (5 mL, 2.4 mm ID, ETFE) at 95 deg C.
Install assigned feeds A:pump_e_series_blue, B:pump_e_series_blue.
Set the outlet BPR to 7 bar gauge and start liquid feeds at final outlet flow 0.1 mL/min.
post_reactor_steps: Effluent from Stage 2 reactor passes through the 7 bar BPR and is collected at ambient temperature. No inline quench required (Chemistry Plan: quench_required = false). Workup proceeds offline per batch protocol.
Collect only after the canonical residence-time stabilization period; use the inventory-compiled downstream path.
Collect only after the canonical residence-time stabilization period; use the inventory-compiled downstream path.
For shutdown, stop reactive cofeeds and reagent gas first, flush with a compatible declared solvent, then depressurize through the controlled outlet.

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

uncertainties: specific uncertainty

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

uncertainties: specific uncertainty

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

    "answer": "This is a two-stage DPDTC-mediated amide formation through a thioester intermediate. calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 17.9 min (ratio 0.60) and S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) are both well below batch anchors with no kinetic justification. Under yield-priority policy, both stages carry meaningful under-exposure risk for an uncharacterized reaction. Too short to serve as a credible starting point.
uncertainties: S1 thioester conversion adequacy at 17.9 min entirely unknown.
S2 aminolysis completeness at 14.3 min unknown.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 16.7 min (ratio 0.56) is modestly short but S2 hold 33.3 min (ratio 1.11) exceeds batch anchor — appropriate for yield-priority given S2 aminolysis is the product-forming step. PFA 2 mL coil (S1) and ETFE 5 mL (S2) are correctly rated. Practical flow rates. Well-balanced exploratory starting point per objective.
uncertainties: S1 conversion at 16.7 min sub-batch — thioester yield feeding S2 unknown.
Stream B 2.1 M benzylamine solubility unconfirmed.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 35.7 min (ratio 1.19) exceeds batch anchor — supports high thioester conversion before amine addition. S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) is sub-batch but aminolysis with benzylamine may be fast; this asymmetry is a reasonable exploratory hypothesis under yield priority. Higher throughput than C2.
uncertainties: S2 aminolysis completeness at 14.3 min unverified — could limit final amide yield.
Extended S1 thioester stability at 95 °C uncharacterized.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 31.3 min (ratio 1.04) and S2 25.0 min (ratio 0.83) bracket the batch anchors closely in both stages. Both ETFE 5 mL coils at 95 °C. Balanced near-batch design is a strong yield-priority anchor; S2 slightly sub-batch is acceptable as a starting screen point.
uncertainties: S2 at 25 min sub-batch; aminolysis extent unconfirmed.
ETFE 5 mL coil used twice — inventory quantity is 2, permissible.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 25.0 min (ratio 0.83) slightly sub-batch; S2 50.0 min (ratio 1.67) substantially exceeds anchor. Yield-priority rationale for extended S2 is plausible if aminolysis is slow, but prolonged 95 °C exposure in S2 carries untested degradation risk. Informative but not the preferred starting design.
uncertainties: S1 thioester conversion adequacy at 25 min unverified.
S2 product degradation risk at 50 min/95 °C uncharacterized.

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 17.9 min (ratio 0.60) and S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) are both well below batch anchors with no kinetic justification. Under yield-priority policy, both stages carry meaningful under-exposure risk for an uncharacterized reaction. Too short to serve as a credible starting point.
uncertainties: S1 thioester conversion adequacy at 17.9 min entirely unknown.
S2 aminolysis completeness at 14.3 min unknown.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 16.7 min (ratio 0.56) is modestly short but S2 hold 33.3 min (ratio 1.11) exceeds batch anchor — appropriate for yield-priority given S2 aminolysis is the product-forming step. PFA 2 mL coil (S1) and ETFE 5 mL (S2) are correctly rated. Practical flow rates. Well-balanced exploratory starting point per objective.
uncertainties: S1 conversion at 16.7 min sub-batch — thioester yield feeding S2 unknown.
Stream B 2.1 M benzylamine solubility unconfirmed.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 35.7 min (ratio 1.19) exceeds batch anchor — supports high thioester conversion before amine addition. S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) is sub-batch but aminolysis with benzylamine may be fast; this asymmetry is a reasonable exploratory hypothesis under yield priority. Higher throughput than C2.
uncertainties: S2 aminolysis completeness at 14.3 min unverified — could limit final amide yield.
Extended S1 thioester stability at 95 °C uncharacterized.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 31.3 min (ratio 1.04) and S2 25.0 min (ratio 0.83) bracket the batch anchors closely in both stages. Both ETFE 5 mL coils at 95 °C. Balanced near-batch design is a strong yield-priority anchor; S2 slightly sub-batch is acceptable as a starting screen point.
uncertainties: S2 at 25 min sub-batch; aminolysis extent unconfirmed.
ETFE 5 mL coil used twice — inventory quantity is 2, permissible.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 25.0 min (ratio 0.83) slightly sub-batch; S2 50.0 min (ratio 1.67) substantially exceeds anchor. Yield-priority rationale for extended S2 is plausible if aminolysis is slow, but prolonged 95 °C exposure in S2 carries untested degradation risk. Informative but not the preferred starting design.
uncertainties: S1 thioester conversion adequacy at 25 min unverified.
S2 product degradation risk at 50 min/95 °C uncharacterized.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 62.5 min (ratio 2.08) is 2× batch anchor — plausible for ensuring full thioester conversion but carries untested intermediate degradation risk. S2 25.0 min (ratio 0.83) is sub-batch. Useful for mapping S1 long-hold sensitivity but less well-justified than C3/C4 for a starting design.
uncertainties: Thioester stability at 62.5 min/95 °C uncharacterized.
S2 aminolysis extent at 25 min unconfirmed.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 62.5 min (ratio 2.08) and S2 50.0 min (ratio 1.67) both exceed batch anchors substantially. Uses two ETFE 10 mL coils — inventory has 2 units, permissible. uncertainties: Both stages carry untested intermediate/product degradation risk at 95 °C.

uncertainties: ETFE-to-PFA transition at S2 mixer — connection compatibility requires lab confirmation.
Same degradation risk as C7/C9.

pre_reactor_steps: Prepare Stream A solution by dissolving 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid (1.0 equiv), DPDTC (1.05 equiv), and DMAP (0.10 equiv) in 2-MeTHF at 0.5 M substrate concentration. No deoxygenation required (ambient atmosphere per protocol).
Prepare Stream B solution by dissolving benzylamine (2.1 M) in 2-MeTHF. Keep Stream B reservoir separate from Stream A to respect the benzylamine/DPDTC incompatible pair.
Pre-heat both heated coil zones (Stage 1 and Stage 2) to 95 C and allow thermal equilibration before introducing reagent streams.
Set BPR to 7 bar before starting flow to keep 2-MeTHF (bp 80 C) fully liquid at 95 C operating temperature.
post_reactor_steps: Effluent from Stage 2 reactor passes through the 7 bar BPR and is collected at ambient temperature. No inline quench required (Chemistry Plan: quench_required = false). Workup proceeds offline per batch protocol.
proposal.chemistry_notes: Two-stage thermal nucleophilic acyl substitution. Stage 1 (PFA 10 mL coil, 95 C, 25 min): 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid + DPDTC + DMAP (10 mol%) form 2-pyridyl thioester intermediate in 2-MeTHF. Stage 2 (PFA 10 mL coil, 95 C, 20 min): benzylamine added via T-mixer to Stage 1 effluent; aminolysis of thioester yields N-benzyl-3-methyl-4-nitrobenzamide and 2-pyridinethiol byproduct. Key design decisions: (1) Benzylamine separated into Stream B to avoid premature contact with DPDTC (incompatible pair per Chemistry Plan). (2) BPR 7 bar required because 2-MeTHF bp = 80 C and operating T = 95 C; 7 bar fixed BPR (bpr_row6) provides adequate suppression. (3) PFA coils used for both stages (max 100 C, 34 bar) — FEP coils excluded because max_temperature_C = 50 C. (4) Analogy 1 confirmed 0.5 M concentration and 30 min batch-to-flow residence time at comparable thermal conditions; no intensification claimed since kinetics are uncharacterized. (5) Flow rates set to give ca. 25 min (Stage 1) and 20 min (Stage 2) residence times as screening starting points anchored to 30 min batch times; consistent with engineering calculation tau_target = 30 min scaled down for practical screening. (6) Red pump tubing excluded for 2-MeTHF per inventory; pump_e_series_blue and pump_r_series_hplc used. (7) CO2 may be evolved in Stage 1 (mechanism step 3 hypothesis); BPR at 7 bar will suppress slug flow from dissolved gas.

stage_parameters.residence_time_basis: V_R2 / (Q_A + Q_B) = 5.0 mL / 0.50 mL/min = 10.0 min; screening starting point anchored to batch Stage 2 = 30 min; shorter time used first given aminolysis of activated thioesters is typically fast; residence time can be extended by switching to second 5 mL coil_row4 in series
stage_parameters.notes: T-mixer P-632 (ETFE) merges Stage 1 effluent and Stream B. Combined flow 0.50 mL/min. Substrate concentration in Stage 2 diluted to 0.5*(0.4/0.5) = 0.40 M; benzylamine in Stage 2 = 2.1*(0.10/0.50) = 0.42 M = 1.05 equiv relative to 0.40 M substrate. Stoichiometry maintained.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Stage 1: 25 min (V=10 mL / Q=0.4 mL/min). Stage 2: 10 min starting point (V=5 mL / Q=0.5 mL/min), extendable to 20 min with second 5 mL coil in series. Batch anchor = 30 min each stage (Chemistry Plan timed_holds). Analogy 1 (similar thermal condensation, 0.5 M, 30 min flow residence time at 250 C) directly supports 30 min batch time as reference; no kinetic intensification claimed. Analogy 2 shows 20 min flow residence time at 60 C for thermal reaction from 5 min batch; suggests near-batch times are appropriate for initial screening. Engineering calculation: tau=60 min (30+30 batch) scaled to practical flow volumes — 25 min + 10 min provides a shorter screening starting point consistent with objective of 'shortest reasonably justified residence times'.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Pure liquid two-stage design; no gas streams. Basis is reactor volume divided by volumetric liquid flow rate entering each stage. Stage 1: Q_A only. Stage 2: Q_A + Q_B combined.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Protocol fact: 95 C both stages (Chemistry Plan timed_holds). Analogy 1 used 250 C (SNAr, different mechanism) — not applicable for temperature transfer. Analogy 2 used 60 C — not applicable. Temperature held at batch value; no intensification justified without kinetic data.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Chemistry Plan: BPR required because 2-MeTHF bp = 80 C and T_op = 95 C (bp < T + 20 C rule satisfied). Fixed BPR 7 bar (bpr_row6) selected from inventory. 7 bar well above vapor pressure of 2-MeTHF at 95 C (~0.3 bar absolute estimated) and suppresses any CO2 evolution from Stage 1 mechanism. Adjustable BPR max 8 bar (bpr_row3) is alternative if pressure tuning needed.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA selected: max 100 C per inventory, compatible with 95 C operation and 2-MeTHF solvent. FEP coils excluded (max 50 C per inventory). No light required so UV transparency is not a selection criterion. ETFE coils available (max 100 C) but 1 mm ID PFA preferred for plug flow and lower pressure drop.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Protocol fact: 0.5 M substrate in Stage 1 (1.0 mL 2-MeTHF, 0.5 mmol batch). Chemistry Plan stream_logic Stream A = 0.5 M. Analogy 1 also used 0.5 M — directly consistent. Dilution to 0.40 M in Stage 2 after benzylamine stream addition is a geometric consequence of flow ratio 0.4:0.1.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_type: Coil reactor per Chemistry Plan stage definitions. Both stages use coil reactors. Inventory: PFA coil 10 mL (coil_row5) for Stage 1; PFA coil 5 mL (coil_row4, first of two available) for Stage 2 initial screen.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: 1.0 mm ID PFA coils from inventory (coil_row4, coil_row5). Engineering calculation confirms Re ~ 8-11 at these flow rates — well within laminar regime. Pe = 691 per calculation confirms plug flow.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Stage 1: 10 mL (coil_row5, PFA 10 mL / 1 mm). Stage 2: 5 mL (coil_row4, PFA 5 mL / 1 mm). Total reactor volume = 15 mL. Primary reported value refers to Stage 1 coil; Stage 2 coil separately listed in stage_parameters.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Total flow rate at Stage 2 = Q_A + Q_B = 0.40 + 0.10 = 0.50 mL/min. Engineering calculation baseline Q_total = 0.500 mL/min — exact match. Analogy 1: 0.5 mL/min each stream, 1.0 mL/min total — same order of magnitude. Pump: E-series blue or R-series HPLC, both capable of 0.40 and 0.10 mL/min with 0.01 mL/min increment.
reasoning_per_field.light_setup: No light required. Chemistry Plan: requires_light = false for both stages. All UV-150 and LED sources unused.
reasoning_per_field.deoxygenation_method: None required. Chemistry Plan: deoxygenation_required = false. Protocol explicitly states ambient atmosphere without argon/nitrogen purging.
reasoning_per_field.mixer_type: T-mixer (P-632, ETFE, 34 bar) placed between Stage 1 and Stage 2 reactors to merge Stage 1 effluent with Stream B (benzylamine). Chemistry Plan mixing_order_reasoning requires sequential addition. P-632 is abundant in inventory (22 units available).

Install Stage 1 reactor coil_row11 (5 mL, 2.4 mm ID, ETFE) at 95 deg C.

Set the outlet BPR to 7 bar gauge and start liquid feeds at final outlet flow 0.1 mL/min.

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

uncertainties: specific uncertainty

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

uncertainties: specific uncertainty

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 17.9 min (ratio 0.60) and S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) are both well below batch anchors with no kinetic justification. Under yield-priority policy, both stages carry meaningful under-exposure risk for an uncharacterized reaction. Too short to serve as a credible starting point.
uncertainties: S1 thioester conversion adequacy at 17.9 min entirely unknown.
S2 aminolysis completeness at 14.3 min unknown.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 16.7 min (ratio 0.56) is modestly short but S2 hold 33.3 min (ratio 1.11) exceeds batch anchor — appropriate for yield-priority given S2 aminolysis is the product-forming step. PFA 2 mL coil (S1) and ETFE 5 mL (S2) are correctly rated. Practical flow rates. Well-balanced exploratory starting point per objective.
uncertainties: S1 conversion at 16.7 min sub-batch — thioester yield feeding S2 unknown.
Stream B 2.1 M benzylamine solubility unconfirmed.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 35.7 min (ratio 1.19) exceeds batch anchor — supports high thioester conversion before amine addition. S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) is sub-batch but aminolysis with benzylamine may be fast; this asymmetry is a reasonable exploratory hypothesis under yield priority. Higher throughput than C2.
uncertainties: S2 aminolysis completeness at 14.3 min unverified — could limit final amide yield.
Extended S1 thioester stability at 95 °C uncharacterized.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 31.3 min (ratio 1.04) and S2 25.0 min (ratio 0.83) bracket the batch anchors closely in both stages. Both ETFE 5 mL coils at 95 °C. Balanced near-batch design is a strong yield-priority anchor; S2 slightly sub-batch is acceptable as a starting screen point.
uncertainties: S2 at 25 min sub-batch; aminolysis extent unconfirmed.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 17.9 min (ratio 0.60) and S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) are both well below batch anchors with no kinetic justification. Under yield-priority policy, both stages carry meaningful under-exposure risk for an uncharacterized reaction. Too short to serve as a credible starting point.
uncertainties: S1 thioester conversion adequacy at 17.9 min entirely unknown.
S2 aminolysis completeness at 14.3 min unknown.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 16.7 min (ratio 0.56) is modestly short but S2 hold 33.3 min (ratio 1.11) exceeds batch anchor — appropriate for yield-priority given S2 aminolysis is the product-forming step. PFA 2 mL coil (S1) and ETFE 5 mL (S2) are correctly rated. Practical flow rates. Well-balanced exploratory starting point per objective.
uncertainties: S1 conversion at 16.7 min sub-batch — thioester yield feeding S2 unknown.
Stream B 2.1 M benzylamine solubility unconfirmed.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 35.7 min (ratio 1.19) exceeds batch anchor — supports high thioester conversion before amine addition. S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) is sub-batch but aminolysis with benzylamine may be fast; this asymmetry is a reasonable exploratory hypothesis under yield priority. Higher throughput than C2.

mechanism_steps.description: Hypothesis: DMAP attacks DPDTC to form a DMAP-thionocarbonate activated intermediate, releasing 2-pyridinol/2-pyridinethiol.
Hypothesis: The carboxylate oxygen of 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid attacks the activated DMAP-thionocarbonate, forming a mixed carbonate-thioester intermediate and regenerating DMAP.

Hypothesis: Rearrangement/elimination of the mixed intermediate yields the 2-pyridyl thioester of 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid with loss of CO2 and 2-pyridinol. This step is hypothesized to potentially be rate-limiting in Stage 1 due to the thermal energy required.
Benzylamine attacks the thioester carbonyl carbon, forming a tetrahedral intermediate.
Collapse of the tetrahedral intermediate expels 2-pyridinethiol and yields N-benzyl-3-methyl-4-nitrobenzamide.

chemistry_plan.mixing_order_reasoning: Stream A feeds Stage 1 reactor at 95 °C for thioester formation. After Stage 1, Stream B (benzylamine) is mixed into the Stage 1 effluent via a T-mixer before entering Stage 2 reactor at 95 °C. Benzylamine must not contact DPDTC prior to thioester formation to avoid competing direct amidation or urea byproduct formation. The batch protocol explicitly cools, opens, adds benzylamine, then reheats — in flow, sequential addition at a T-mixer between heated coils achieves the same temporal separation.
chemistry_plan.deoxygenation_reasoning: Batch protocol explicitly states reaction performed under ambient atmosphere without argon or nitrogen purging. No oxygen-sensitive intermediates identified.
chemistry_plan.quench_reasoning: Batch protocol proceeds directly to workup after Stage 2 without an inline quench step. No highly reactive intermediates persist post-reaction.
chemistry_plan.confidence_notes: 1. The exact mechanism of DPDTC-mediated thioester formation (steps 1-3) is a model hypothesis based on analogy to known thionocarbonate chemistry; the literature-confirmed identity is the 2-pyridyl thioester intermediate. 2. The rate-limiting step assignment (step 3) is a hypothesis — no measured kinetic data are available. 3. Whether CO2 is evolved in Stage 1 is mechanistically plausible but unconfirmed; if CO2 evolution occurs, slug flow may develop in the Stage 1 coil, which could affect residence time distribution. A BPR would help suppress gas bubble formation. 4. The 2.1 M concentration of benzylamine in Stream B assumes full solubility in 2-MeTHF; benzylamine is miscible with most ethers so this is expected to be feasible but should be verified. 5. No batch yield data were provided, so no conversion prediction is made. 6. BPR is critical: 2-MeTHF bp is 80 °C and the reaction runs at 95 °C; a 7 or 8 bar fixed BPR should provide adequate pressure to keep the solvent liquid. 7. Red pump tubing is excluded for 2-MeTHF per inventory constraints; only blue pump tubing or HPLC pumps should be used for 2-MeTHF-containing streams.

batch_record.raw_text: A 4.0 mL vial equipped with a PTFE stir bar was charged with 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid (1 equiv, 0.5 mmol), N,N-dimethylpyridin-4-amine (DMAP) (6.1 mg, 0.1 equiv, 0.05 mmol), and DPDTC (130. mg, 1.05 equiv, 0.525 mmol) under ambient atmosphere without argon or nitrogen purging.  2-MeTHF (1.0 mL, 0.5 M) was added, and the vial was capped and sealed with Teflon tape. The reaction vial was placed in a pre-heated oil bath maintained at 95 °C and stirred at 500–600 rpm for 30 min. The vial was removed from the oil bath and allowed to cool at room temperature for 5–10 min. Once cooled, the cap was removed and benzylamine (1.05 equiv, 0.525 mmol) and 2-MeTHF (0.25 mL, 0.4 M) were quickly added. The vial was capped, sealed with Teflon tape, and returned to the oil bath at 95 °C, and stirred at 500–600 rpm for another 30 min before workup.

hypotheses: Stage 1 requires sufficient conversion to generate enough thioester for Stage 2. Stage 2 requires sufficient reaction time for conversion to the final amide. Use the batch temperature and reaction times as reference conditions rather than fixed targets, and determine the operating conditions based on flow performance. Evaluate the overall process based on the final amide yield rather than either stage alone. The Stream A/Stream B molar ratio should reflect the intended stoichiometry based on both concentration and flow rate.

answers.answer: Prioritize high conversion through both stages and a high final amide yield. Choose the shortest residence times reasonably justified for this conversion-focused starting design rather than adding a large time excess by default. Keep reactor volumes and flow rates practical for flow screening.

This is a two-stage DPDTC-mediated amide formation through a thioester intermediate. In Stage 1, 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid is converted to the corresponding 2-pyridyl thioester using DPDTC and DMAP, without isolating the intermediate. In Stage 2, benzylamine is added to the Stage 1 effluent to form N-benzyl-3-methyl-4-nitrobenzamide. The amide C(O)–N bond is formed and the thioester C(O)–S bond is cleaved during Stage 2.

Stage 1 requires sufficient conversion to generate enough thioester for Stage 2. Stage 2 requires sufficient reaction time for conversion to the final amide. Use the batch temperature and reaction times as reference conditions rather than fixed targets, and determine the operating conditions based on flow performance. Evaluate the overall process based on the final amide yield rather than either stage alone. The Stream A/Stream B molar ratio should reflect the intended stoichiometry based on both concentration and flow rate.

answer.equipment_assembly_policy: Mount tubing only in its declared compatible module, respecting module capacity, temperature and shared quantity. UV-150 lights are not detachable: use UV-150 with an E-series or R-series platform; external syringe cofeeds are permitted when necessary. Manual modules use their own strip lights.
answer.pump_platform_policy: Prefer compatible channels within one system. Mixed platforms are permitted but disfavored; justify necessity, especially reagent incompatibility requiring an external syringe pump. Do not force every UV-150 feed onto system pumps.
answer.reporting: Report each feed component concentration, molar flow and equivalent; distinguish theoretical intermediate concentration. Report gas volume at inlet STP in mL/min.
catalog_projection_limits: Fabricatable tubing remains stock, not installed reactor candidates; strict < versus up-to volume needs confirmation.
Red/green strip wavelengths unspecified: retained in source catalog, not wavelength-selectable candidates.
Integrated H-Cube retained in source catalog, not decomposed into external pump/MFC/BPR.
Unknown check-valve pressure rating and MFC quantity require laboratory verification.
Compatibility PDF is not a certification for unlisted solutes or mixtures.
answer.pump_setting_policy: Minimum flow is the lower operating limit. Adjustment flow is the setting increment, represented as multiples of that increment; jointly solve all feeds without changing stated stoichiometry.

proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan: benzylamine must not contact DPDTC before Stage 1 is complete to avoid direct amide or urea byproduct. Stream A traverses Stage 1 coil alone at 95 C for thioester formation. Effluent from Stage 1 is then merged with Stream B at a T-mixer (P-632, ETFE, 34 bar rated) located between Stage 1 and Stage 2 reactors. pre_reactor_steps: Prepare Stream A containing 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid (1.0 equiv, 0.5 M), DPDTC (1.05 equiv, 0.525 M), DMAP (0.1 equiv, 0.05 M), 2-MeTHF (2-methyltetrahydrofuran) in 2-MeTHF (2-methyltetrahydrofuran) at 0.5 M; concentration basis: reference component: 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid.
Prepare Stream B containing benzylamine (1.05 equiv, 2.1 M) in 2-MeTHF (2-methyltetrahydrofuran) at 2.1 M; concentration basis: reference component: benzylamine.
Install Stage 1 reactor coil_row11 (5 mL, 2.4 mm ID, ETFE) at 95 deg C.
Install Stage 2 reactor coil_row11 (5 mL, 2.4 mm ID, ETFE) at 95 deg C.
Install assigned feeds A:pump_e_series_blue, B:pump_e_series_blue.
Set the outlet BPR to 7 bar gauge and start liquid feeds at final outlet flow 0.35 mL/min.
post_reactor_steps: Effluent from Stage 2 reactor passes through the 7 bar BPR and is collected at ambient temperature. No inline quench required (Chemistry Plan: quench_required = false). Workup proceeds offline per batch protocol.

proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan: benzylamine must not contact DPDTC before Stage 1 is complete to avoid direct amide or urea byproduct. Stream A traverses Stage 1 coil alone at 95 C for thioester formation. Effluent from Stage 1 is then merged with Stream B at a T-mixer (P-632, ETFE, 34 bar rated) located between Stage 1 and Stage 2 reactors. The combined stream enters Stage 2 coil at 95 C for aminolysis.
pre_reactor_steps: Prepare Stream A containing 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid (1.0 equiv, 0.5 M), DPDTC (1.05 equiv, 0.525 M), DMAP (0.1 equiv, 0.05 M), 2-MeTHF (2-methyltetrahydrofuran) in 2-MeTHF (2-methyltetrahydrofuran) at 0.5 M; concentration basis: reference component: 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid.
Prepare Stream B containing benzylamine (1.05 equiv, 2.1 M) in 2-MeTHF (2-methyltetrahydrofuran) at 2.1 M; concentration basis: reference component: benzylamine.
Install Stage 1 reactor coil_row3 (2 mL, 1 mm ID, PFA) at 95 deg C.
Install Stage 2 reactor coil_row11 (5 mL, 2.4 mm ID, ETFE) at 95 deg C.
Install assigned feeds A:pump_e_series_blue, B:pump_e_series_blue.
Set the outlet BPR to 7 bar gauge and start liquid feeds at final outlet flow 0.1 mL/min.
post_reactor_steps: Effluent from Stage 2 reactor passes through the 7 bar BPR and is collected at ambient temperature. No inline quench required (Chemistry Plan: quench_required = false). Workup proceeds offline per batch protocol.
Collect only after the canonical residence-time stabilization period; use the inventory-compiled downstream path.
Collect only after the canonical residence-time stabilization period; use the inventory-compiled downstream path.
For shutdown, stop reactive cofeeds and reagent gas first, flush with a compatible declared solvent, then depressurize through the controlled outlet.

proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan: benzylamine must not contact DPDTC before Stage 1 is complete to avoid direct amide or urea byproduct. Stream A traverses Stage 1 coil alone at 95 C for thioester formation. Effluent from Stage 1 is then merged with Stream B at a T-mixer (P-632, ETFE, 34 bar rated) located between Stage 1 and Stage 2 reactors. The combined stream enters Stage 2 coil at 95 C for aminolysis.

Prepare Stream B containing benzylamine (1.05 equiv, 2.1 M) in 2-MeTHF (2-methyltetrahydrofuran) at 2.1 M; concentration basis: reference component: benzylamine.
Install Stage 1 reactor coil_row12 (10 mL, 2.4 mm ID, ETFE) at 95 deg C.
Install Stage 2 reactor coil_row11 (5 mL, 2.4 mm ID, ETFE) at 95 deg C.
Install assigned feeds A:pump_e_series_blue, B:pump_e_series_blue.
Set the outlet BPR to 7 bar gauge and start liquid feeds at final outlet flow 0.1 mL/min.
post_reactor_steps: Effluent from Stage 2 reactor passes through the 7 bar BPR and is collected at ambient temperature. No inline quench required (Chemistry Plan: quench_required = false). Workup proceeds offline per batch protocol.
Collect only after the canonical residence-time stabilization period; use the inventory-compiled downstream path.

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

uncertainties: specific uncertainty

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

uncertainties: specific uncertainty

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 17.9 min (ratio 0.60) and S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) are both well below batch anchors with no kinetic justification. Under yield-priority policy, both stages carry meaningful under-exposure risk for an uncharacterized reaction. Too short to serve as a credible starting point.
uncertainties: S1 thioester conversion adequacy at 17.9 min entirely unknown.
S2 aminolysis completeness at 14.3 min unknown.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 16.7 min (ratio 0.56) is modestly short but S2 hold 33.3 min (ratio 1.11) exceeds batch anchor — appropriate for yield-priority given S2 aminolysis is the product-forming step. PFA 2 mL coil (S1) and ETFE 5 mL (S2) are correctly rated. Practical flow rates. Well-balanced exploratory starting point per objective.
uncertainties: S1 conversion at 16.7 min sub-batch — thioester yield feeding S2 unknown.
Stream B 2.1 M benzylamine solubility unconfirmed.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 35.7 min (ratio 1.19) exceeds batch anchor — supports high thioester conversion before amine addition. S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) is sub-batch but aminolysis with benzylamine may be fast; this asymmetry is a reasonable exploratory hypothesis under yield priority. Higher throughput than C2.
uncertainties: S2 aminolysis completeness at 14.3 min unverified — could limit final amide yield.
Extended S1 thioester stability at 95 °C uncharacterized.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 31.3 min (ratio 1.04) and S2 25.0 min (ratio 0.83) bracket the batch anchors closely in both stages. Both ETFE 5 mL coils at 95 °C. Balanced near-batch design is a strong yield-priority anchor; S2 slightly sub-batch is acceptable as a starting screen point.
uncertainties: S2 at 25 min sub-batch; aminolysis extent unconfirmed.
ETFE 5 mL coil used twice — inventory quantity is 2, permissible.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 25.0 min (ratio 0.83) slightly sub-batch; S2 50.0 min (ratio 1.67) substantially exceeds anchor. Yield-priority rationale for extended S2 is plausible if aminolysis is slow, but prolonged 95 °C exposure in S2 carries untested degradation risk. Informative but not the preferred starting design.
uncertainties: S1 thioester conversion adequacy at 25 min unverified.
S2 product degradation risk at 50 min/95 °C uncharacterized.

uncertainties: Thioester stability at 62.5 min/95 °C uncharacterized.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 62.5 min (ratio 2.08) and S2 50.0 min (ratio 1.67) both exceed batch anchors substantially. Uses two ETFE 10 mL coils — inventory has 2 units, permissible.
